# Back link

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a back link to return users to the previous page, in its previous state, within a multi-page transaction.

## When to use

- Always include a back link on question pages in a GOV.UK service.
- Use it on another page in a multi-page transaction when returning to the previous state helps users.

## When not to use

- Never use a back link and breadcrumbs together on the same page.
- Do not use it as a general navigation link to an unrelated or fixed destination.

## Anatomy

- **Anchor (required):** A real href returns to the previous page and retains its state without requiring JavaScript.
- **Label (required):** Usually “Back”; a complex journey may name the destination to remove ambiguity.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `a` | `govuk-back-link` | At the top of an ordinary service page. |
| Inverse | `a` | `govuk-back-link`, `govuk-back-link--inverse` | On a dark background that maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast with white. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Place the link before the main element so the page skip link can bypass it with other navigation.
- Prefer a server-generated href. If it cannot work without JavaScript, hide it until JavaScript is available.
- Return the user to the prior page as they last saw it, including entered state.

## Accessibility contract

- Keep native anchor semantics and a visible focus indicator.
- Do not move the link into main solely to silence automated landmark warnings; official guidance places it before main.
- For the inverse variant, verify white link contrast against the actual background.

## Content rules

- Use “Back” for a simple linear journey.
- For a complex journey use specific text such as “Go back to applications” when “Back” is unclear.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.link`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`
- `govuk.color.inverse-text`

## HTML examples

### Default back link

```html
<a href="/previous-step" class="govuk-back-link">Back</a>
```
